thresholds._comment: percentile mode self-calibrates: the top slice of each scan earns a directional call, so the ledger always gets falsifiable predictions to learn from. absoluteFloor stops it calling long on the best of a bad field.

social._comment: Social provider for the attention pillar. Rate-limited, so only the top `enrichTopN` tokens by composite get a lookup. Set LUNARCRUSH_API_KEY in .env to activate.

adapt._comment: Self-adaptation. `node run.mjs adapt` regresses graded outcomes against the feature vector and writes data/adapted_weights.json. Nothing is applied until apply=true.

agents._comment: The paid panel. Runs only when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set AND a token crosses the promotion gate. Tune promoteScore/deltaThreshold/staleMinutes to trade cost against coverage.
